None of the required changes in `src/types/messages.ts`, `src/types/session.ts`, `src/transport/ws/validation.ts`, `src/transport/ws/messageHandler.ts`, `src/transport/createServer.ts`, or `src/config.ts` are present. Consequently, all new tests in `conversationList.acceptance.test.ts` will fail immediately.
